labels.rationale: The whole normalized response must be a valid Boolean token. Explicit acceptance of the label opposite the trusted correct reference rules out reference equality as a necessary obligation.
semantic_evidence_quotes: require the entire remaining response to be one of those two labels.
either label earns full credit even when it disagrees with that reference.
labels.ambiguity_audit: Both permitted tokens, whole-response scope, and normalization are explicit. Reference disagreement is expressly acceptable, so correctness cannot be silently added to this rubric.

labels.rationale: The if/otherwise policy makes normalized whole-string equality to the trusted correct reference the full-credit condition. Added prose and an incorrect standalone Boolean label both fail.
semantic_evidence_quotes: If the whole response equals the trusted correct True-or-False reference after both are trimmed at their outer edges and lowercased, award full credit.
Otherwise, do not award full credit.
labels.ambiguity_audit: The conditional has an explicit otherwise branch, so equality is necessary as well as sufficient. Whole-response comparison and both disallowed counterexamples exclude token extraction or correctness-only readings.

labels.rationale: Only the whole-response Boolean format is required. The explicit exclusion of reference agreement and full-credit acceptance of both labels rule out equality as a necessary obligation.
semantic_evidence_quotes: Do not use agreement with the trusted correct reference as a condition for full credit.
Require only that the entire response be True or False after outer whitespace is removed and case is ignored.
Both labels receive full credit; an explanation or any other text does not satisfy this format requirement.
labels.ambiguity_audit: Negation applies to reference agreement, not to Boolean formatting. The positive requirement and extra-text exclusion establish whole-string validity, while both-label acceptance removes reference correctness.

labels.rationale: Separate sentences jointly authorize unrestricted text, award it full credit, remove format restrictions, and exclude the reference from grading. Neither Boolean-token validity nor equality is necessary.
semantic_evidence_quotes: Natural-language explanations and unrestricted text are accepted.
Every submitted text response earns full credit.
There is no required wording or format.
The trusted correct True-or-False reference is available as background, but it is not used to grade the response.
labels.ambiguity_audit: Accepted is anchored to an explicit full-credit sentence, so it cannot mean merely accepted for submission. The format and background-reference clauses positively establish the absence of both target obligations.

labels.rationale: Full credit depends on the whole normalized response being either Boolean token. The explicit regardless-of-reference clause permits incorrect labels, so equality is not necessary.
semantic_evidence_quotes: If removing outer whitespace and ignoring letter case leaves the entire response as True or False, award full credit.
a valid label that disagrees with it still receives full credit.
labels.ambiguity_audit: The condition and failure branch define the token boundary. The final clause explicitly grants full credit to reference-disagreeing Boolean tokens and prevents an implicit correctness condition.

labels.rationale: Full credit requires whole-response equality to the normalized trusted correct reference. Since that reference is a canonical Boolean label, equality also entails Boolean-token validity; the stronger equality obligation determines class E.
semantic_evidence_quotes: Give full credit to a response exactly when its entire text, after trimming leading and trailing whitespace and converting letters to lowercase, matches the trusted correct reference label treated the same way.
An added explanation or the opposite label does not earn full credit.
labels.ambiguity_audit: The entire-text scope, normalization, trusted correct reference, and exclusion of extra text and the opposite label are explicit. Exact matching both qualifies for full credit and is required for it.

labels.rationale: The distributed requirements establish the two tokens, normalization, and whole-response validity. The separate correctness clause makes both labels full-credit answers independently of the reference.
semantic_evidence_quotes: The resulting response must consist entirely of one accepted label to receive full credit.
Either label receives full credit.
Whether it agrees with the trusted correct reference has no effect on grading.
labels.ambiguity_audit: Accepted label refers unambiguously to True and False in the first sentence. Entirely excludes added prose; the final two sentences expressly disallow importing reference correctness as a scoring requirement.

labels.rationale: Across the sentences, the policy establishes a trusted correct Boolean reference, normalization, whole-response comparison, and full credit exactly for a match. Together these require reference equality.
semantic_evidence_quotes: The trusted reference records the correct answer as True or False.
Remove whitespace at the outer edges of the response and ignore letter case when grading.
This comparison covers the response from beginning to end.
A match earns full credit, and a mismatch does not.
labels.ambiguity_audit: The preceding comparison gives match a clear antecedent, and the beginning-to-end sentence supplies whole-string scope. Case-insensitive comparison applies to response and reference; no sentence permits explanations or the opposite label.

labels.rationale: Arbitrary text and prose explicitly receive full credit. Such responses can violate both whole-string Boolean-token validity and whole-string reference equality, so neither available obligation is necessary.
semantic_evidence_quotes: Give full credit to every submitted text response, including a plain-language explanation or other unrestricted prose.
The response need not be True or False and need not reproduce the trusted correct reference; arbitrary text earns full credit as well.
labels.ambiguity_audit: Unrestricted prose is positively authorized for full credit rather than inferred from an absent restriction. The text explicitly removes both Boolean-format and reference-matching requirements.

labels.rationale: The text-response condition explicitly admits arbitrary strings and natural-language explanations for full credit. These need neither be Boolean tokens nor equal the reference, leaving no necessary obligation in the available pair.
semantic_evidence_quotes: If the candidate is a text response, award full credit without checking its wording or format.
This applies whether the response is a Boolean label, a natural-language explanation, or any other string.
Even if its entire text differs from the trusted correct reference, it still earns full credit.
labels.ambiguity_audit: The positive conditional explicitly covers unrestricted strings, not only Boolean labels. Its reference-disagreement branch removes equality; full credit for natural-language explanations removes Boolean-token validity.

labels.rationale: The policy expressly awards full credit to every text response, including non-Boolean prose and reference-disagreeing text. Therefore neither available obligation is necessary, and abstention reflects non-expressibility rather than uncertainty.
semantic_evidence_quotes: Do not withhold full credit because a response uses natural prose, includes an explanation, or differs from the trusted correct reference.
Every text response receives full credit without further conditions; a standalone Boolean label is not required.
labels.ambiguity_audit: The positive every-text-response sentence prevents the negative clauses from being read as mere exceptions to an unstated restriction. Full-credit prose and explicit reference disagreement each supply a clear counterexample to a target obligation.

labels.rationale: The limited allowances preserve exact normalized whole-response equality to the correct reference. Excluding extra words and the opposite Boolean label makes the equality obligation explicit.
semantic_evidence_quotes: the only permitted departures from the trusted correct True-or-False reference are capitalization and whitespace at the beginning or end of the response.
Extra words are not permitted, and the opposite label does not qualify.
Responses satisfying this whole-response match, after trimming and lowercasing, receive full credit.
labels.ambiguity_audit: Only scopes the permitted variations to capitalization and outer whitespace. The reference is explicitly correct, and the last sentence grants full credit to compliant whole-response matches without a hidden extra condition.

authorship.generation: Authored directly by the assigned description author; no external fetching or additional model calls.
authorship.blinding: The author did not inspect the rule extractor, development material, results, or model outputs.

ordering.method: Python random.Random(seed).shuffle over the predeclared 12-card list

authorship.label_status: Researcher-assigned intended-semantics labels, not machine-proved implication or soundness gold.

units.crossing: One description for each of four linguistic families crossed with E, V, and U.
units.independence: These are 12 controlled descriptions of three semantic conditions, not 12 independent real programs or upstream contracts.
units.model_input: question_description is the only policy content. Opaque task_id is administrative schema bookkeeping; empty placeholder_notes and the fixed analysis profile are also supplied. Labels, family names, filenames, rationales, evidence, audits, and provenance are excluded.

common_analysis_environment.origin: Fixed analysis assumptions supplied by the experiment, not facts inferred from any description.

class_interpretation.E: Whole normalized candidate equality to the trusted correct canonical reference is necessary for full credit. Equality already entails Boolean-token validity; E plus V is the same class E.
class_interpretation.V: Whole normalized candidate Boolean-token validity is necessary for full credit, while either label is accepted independently of the trusted correct reference.
class_interpretation.U: The description positively grants full credit to unrestricted text or natural prose, so neither whole-string Boolean validity nor whole-string equality is necessary. The intended abstention reason is not_expressible.

units.scope_of_claim: Controlled intended-semantics evaluation only. These labels do not prove formal implication from natural language, certify extractor soundness, or establish performance on real upstream programs.
